grounded.action: Amends the W5 venue rule again: any cross-venue extension must align fee structures and persistent arb deviations first — venues score as independence only, never as pooled edge.
grounded.note: CEX vs DEX market quality: gas fees burden small DEX trades and cause persistent arbitrage deviations; DEX costs favor large trades instead. Venue marks differ structurally by fee regime.
grounded.title: On The Quality Of Cryptocurrency Markets: Centralized Versus Decentralized Exchanges
